adjustment.startRepeatWeight: Starting at {{to}} {{unit}}, what you used last time, instead of the plan's {{from}} {{unit}}.

adjustment.startDeloadWeightReps: Down to {{to}} {{unit}} × {{reps}} from last time's {{last}} {{unit}} × {{lastReps}} — you had no reps left in reserve.
